title: Choose Caliban's visual world
question: The roll assigned Sovereign Airspace. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sovereign Airspace
options.lineage: En-route air traffic control: radar scope, data blocks and paper flight-progress strips
options.thesis: Caliban is the tower for your company's airspace: every request is a flight it identifies, screens, clears and lands on your own runway.
materials: radar sweep on a blue scope
flight strips in a strip bay
options.viewport: A live radar scope owns the hero: requests enter as targets, pass through rings (policy, PII, route, cache, ground) and land at the sovereign core, while a strip bay prints each cleared request beside the headline and the Talk-to-us action.
options.risk: Reads as an aviation theme if the metaphor leaks into the copy; words stay Caliban's (requests, routes, tenants), and ATC is grammar only.

raised.raise: Every number is a fixed-place readout with its unit engraved beneath, never a floating marketing stat.
Every target carries a leader-lined data block naming its parts: tenant, routed model, PII count, cache state.
One owned Caliban blue is the only chromatic ink; amber appears only for holds and denials.
Each stage shows registered before/after state (raw to pseudonymized, CQIR to pipeline), measured, not described.
Every strip carries its origin ticket: tenant, key, datasource.
Motion follows the pipeline's real stage order and target latencies; nothing moves for decoration.

options.label: Chart of the Isle
options.lineage: Admiralty hydrographic charts: soundings, depth contours, buoyed channels, light sectors
options.thesis: Your data is the island; Caliban surveys every inch of it, and models may only come ashore through charted, buoyed channels.
options.viewport: A full-bleed chart of a customer's island: datasources as surveyed coves, the ontology as depth contours, requests plotted as courses through buoyed channels to the shore.
options.risk: The island is the literal reading of the name and where most runs would land; it turns nostalgic if the chart is not functional.

options.label: Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Caliban as a bank of instruments: tokens saved, PII caught, latency and cache hits glow as fixed-place counters.
options.viewport: A wall of counter banks reading a live request, each stage a tube bank.
options.case: Engineers identify with instruments, but it explains the mechanism less clearly than a tower that routes and lands requests.
options.risk: Becomes a dashboard skin if the counters do not carry the story.

options.label: One Owned Blue
options.thesis: One Caliban blue at full strength on every surface.
options.viewport: The page is the blue; content reverses out in white.
options.case: Recognisable, but proves nothing about routing, grounding or sovereignty.
options.kept: Total commitment to one owned hue.

options.label: Annotated Spread
options.lineage: Fashion mook spreads with hand-drawn annotation ribbons
options.thesis: Every component named by a curling annotation ribbon.
options.viewport: Shingled spreads of the architecture with ribbons naming parts.
options.case: Off-audience for enterprise buyers; its annotation discipline survives as data blocks.
options.kept: Every object names its own parts on a leader line.

options.label: Forge Blows
options.thesis: Each pipeline stage as a hammer blow that visibly reshapes the request.
options.viewport: A billet lengthening blow by blow.
options.case: Violent register for a privacy product; its registered before/after survives.
options.kept: Before and after are registered and measured.

options.label: Moon-Shadow Bazaar
options.thesis: Requests traded like shadows under Caliban's moon.
options.case: Poetic but obscures the product; its origin tickets survive on strips.
options.kept: Every item carries a ticket of origin.

options.label: Ink Basin
options.viewport: A WebGL ink basin answering the pointer.
options.case: Beautiful, says nothing about determinism; its physics-true motion survives.
options.kept: Motion obeys real rules, never decoration.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A developer-infrastructure landing page: centred hero, product screenshot, logo row, feature grid, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every AI gateway ships.
canonCard.risk: This is essentially the look you just rejected as too close to haqq.ai.
